name: phd-nd-bachelors-then-phd
description: A Ph.D. student who did their bachelor's at Notre Dame and entered the Ph.D. straight after, WITH the bachelor's award term set — the state every such student is in since that field became required (2026-09-07). Their Notre Dame undergraduate courses satisfy §4.4.1 core knowledge through the Courses tab, with no ExternalCourses ruling needed, and a 60000-level course taken in the senior year (the §3.5 integrated B.S.+M.S. route) still earns no credit: §5.2 criterion 2 asks for graduate student status, which starts after the bachelor's degree. Nothing here needs a DGS decision, so the §5.2 row is not applicable rather than a permanently amber "needs DGS review" (2026-09-09).

detailIncludes: Nothing here needs a DGS decision
CSE 60111: not counted — taken in the term your bachelor’s degree was awarded (Spring 2024)

CSE 60641: satisfies the Operating Systems core-knowledge requirement (§4.4.1)
CSE 60111: taken in the term your bachelor’s degree was awarded
